city_no_buildings.en: no building has been raised yet

composer_scope.en: one sentence is enough. where it goes and how it runs are both in the line below.
composer_scope.zh: 写一句话就够。送到哪、算什么模式，下面那句里都说了。

composer_example.en: measure every read path in the ledger, find the slowest one, and write down the numbers you got
composer_example.zh: 把账本的读取路径量一遍，找出最慢的那一处，并写下测出来的数

composer_keys.en: Enter sends it, Shift+Enter makes a new line.

composer_source.en: a dotted word is one this city guessed, from where you sent work last and what this city defaults to; a solid one you set yourself. Click any word to change it.
composer_source.zh: 带点线的词是这座城猜的，来自你上一次派活与城的默认；实线的是你自己设的。点任意一个词可以改它。

sessions_scope.en: sessions that are running, or stopped waiting on you. What has ended is in the section below.
sessions_scope.zh: 在跑的与在等你的会话（一间房里的一条工作线）。已经结束的在下面一节。

sessions_source.en: from the event stream, through seq {seq}.
sessions_source.zh: 来自事件流，最后一条 seq {seq}。

sessions_ended_scope.en: the last eight. Any of them can be branched from any one of its turns.
sessions_ended_scope.zh: 最近八件。每一件都可以从任意一轮分出一支接着做。

sessions_ended_source.en: the same event stream; frozen and cancelled are its two endings.
sessions_ended_source.zh: 同一条事件流，冻结与取消两种收尾。

sessions_nothing_yet.en: nothing has been sent out yet.

sessions_nothing_what.en: the box above is where work starts; what you send appears here as a row.
sessions_nothing_what.zh: 上面那个框就是活的起点；送出去的东西会在这里变成一行。

sessions_city_scope.en: which buildings are busy. One block, not a page of its own.
sessions_city_scope.zh: 哪几栋楼在忙。它是一块，不是一页。

session_context_scope.en: context left is the one of these four the wire cannot carry yet: the city measures it, and no query returns it.
session_context_scope.zh: 上下文余量是这四格里唯一线上还没有的：城里量得到，没有任何查询答得出它。

prompt_title.en: this is what went to the model

prompt_scope.en: the four frozen blocks of the prefix, in the order they are cached. The words city, building, resident and run are the ledger's own.
prompt_scope.zh: 前缀的四个冻结块，按缓存的顺序排。city、building、resident、run 四个词是账本自己的写法。

prompt_source.en: read out of this session's own prompt_assembled records; nothing here is hashed a second time.
prompt_source.zh: 从这条会话自己的 prompt_assembled 记录里读出；这里没有任何东西被重新算一遍哈希。

prompt_none.en: this session has not assembled a prompt yet.
prompt_none.zh: 这条会话还没有组装过提示词。

prompt_none_what.en: the first one is written when the first turn opens.
prompt_none_what.zh: 第一份在第一轮开始时落账。

prompt_skills_title.en: what this session was allowed to open
prompt_skills_title.zh: 这条会话被允许打开的东西

prompt_skills_scope.en: the reading room this building admits, and what each document hashed to when the shelf was read.
prompt_skills_scope.zh: 这栋楼准进的阅览室，以及扫架时每份文档的哈希。

prompt_skills_source.en: pinned in run_started, and compared with the newest earlier session that was given the same name.
prompt_skills_source.zh: 钉在 run_started 里，与拿到同一个名字的上一条会话相比。

prompt_no_skills.zh: 这栋楼一个技能都没准进。

prompt_no_skills_what.en: the reading room is a list a person writes in BUILDING.md; a name not on the shelves is left out rather than promised.
prompt_no_skills_what.zh: 阅览室是人在 BUILDING.md 里写的一张单子；单上有而架上没有的名字会被略去，而不是先应承下来。

prompt_skill_first.en: first time this city recorded it

prompt_skill_changed.en: changed since last time, when it was {was}
prompt_skill_changed.zh: 自上次以来变了，当时是 {was}

session_scope.en: one work line in one room. Everything it did is under the tabs.
session_scope.zh: 一间房里的一条工作线。它做过的一切在下面的标签里。

session_source.en: from this session's own slice of the event stream.
session_source.zh: 来自这条会话在事件流里的那一段。

session_unknown.en: this city has no session at that address.
session_unknown.zh: 这座城在那个地址上没有会话。

session_unknown_what.en: it may have been opened by another city, or the link may predate this one.
session_unknown_what.zh: 它可能属于另一座城，也可能这条链接比这座城还老。

waiting_scope.en: everything that cannot move until you answer.
waiting_scope.zh: 所有在你回答之前动不了的东西。

waiting_source.en: approvals from the queue, frozen sessions from the stream.
waiting_source.zh: 审批来自队列，冻结的会话来自事件流。

waiting_nothing_what.en: approvals, gates raised to a person, and a stopped city would all appear here.
waiting_nothing_what.zh: 审批、升给人的门、停住的城，都会出现在这里。

record_scope.en: what this city wrote down, in three lenses over one history.
record_scope.zh: 这座城写下来的东西，一段历史的三个镜头。

first_no_model_title.en: this city cannot send work out yet

first_no_model_scope.en: the first step is one thing: tell it which model to ask. A key on this machine never leaves this machine.
first_no_model_scope.zh: 第一步只有一件事：告诉它去问哪个模型。这台机器上的密钥不会离开这台机器。

first_no_model_status.zh: 没有模型回答 {tag} 这个用途。

first_no_model_what.en: once one does, you write a sentence and it goes out to be done.
first_no_model_what.zh: 接上之后，你写一句话，它就能派出去做。

first_no_model_subscription.en: I have a subscription, not an API key
first_no_model_subscription.zh: 我用的是订阅，不是 API key

first_no_model_source.en: read from the endpoints registered on this machine and the jobs each one answers for.
first_no_model_source.zh: 读的是这台机器上已注册的 endpoint 与它们各自答应的用途。

first_no_building_title.en: there is nowhere to put work yet

first_no_building_scope.en: a building is one line of business, and on disk it is one folder; sending work out opens a room inside it.
first_no_building_scope.zh: 楼（一条业务线，磁盘上就是一个文件夹）是活落脚的地方；一次派活会在楼里开一间房。

first_no_building_status.en: this city has no buildings at all.

first_no_building_what.en: make one, say {example}; after that every piece of work lives in a room under it, named by what you called the work.
first_no_building_what.zh: 建一栋，比如 {example}；之后每一件活都住在它下面的一间房里，房间名就是你给这件活取的名字。

first_no_building_source.en: read from the buildings already under the city root.
first_no_building_source.zh: 读的是城根目录下已有的楼。

first_dispatch_title.en: send out the first piece of work

first_dispatch_scope.en: one sentence is enough; the rest is in the line below. What happens goes into the ledger — this city's whole history, append-only, verifiable offline.
first_dispatch_scope.zh: 写一句话就够，剩下的下面那句里都说了。做完之后，它会把过程完整记进账本（这座城的全部历史，只能追加，可以离线验）。

first_dispatch_keys.en: Enter sends it, Shift+Enter makes a new line. The grey sentence is the size one piece of work should be.
first_dispatch_keys.zh: Enter 送出，Shift+Enter 换行。灰框里那句就是一件活该有的大小。

first_dispatch_source.en: nothing has been sent out yet, so all three words are guesses: the only building there is, mode build, and this city's default depth.
first_dispatch_source.zh: 还没有派过活，所以三个词全是猜的：楼取城里唯一的一栋，模式取 build，思考深度取城的默认。

city_running_idle.en: this city is running, with nothing to do.
city_running_idle.zh: 这座城在运转，只是还没有活可做。

pursuit_scope.en: this building, until the work runs out

pursuit_empty.en: this building is not pursuing anything.
pursuit_empty.zh: 这栋楼没有在追任何目标。

pursuit_empty_what.en: set a goal and the city hands out ready work by itself, stopping when nothing is ready and nothing is in flight.
pursuit_empty_what.zh: 设一个目标，这座城就会自己派出就绪的活；就绪集空且无在途时停下。

pursuit_goal_label.en: what this building is working towards

autonomy_source.zh: 这栋楼自己写下的那一档

vitals_asking.en: asking the city how large it is

asking_what_it_holds.en: asking the city what it holds
asking_what_it_holds.zh: 正在问这座城里有什么

live_nothing_since_connected.en: nothing has happened since this page connected
live_nothing_since_connected.zh: 本页连上之后什么都没发生

live_every_run.en: every run in this city, as it happens
live_every_run.zh: 这座城里的每一个会话，实时

live_scope.en: a bounded window: the figure counts the lines held here, and a line that leaves the window has not left the Ledger
live_scope.zh: 一个有上限的窗口：数字是这里留着的行数，滑出窗口的行并没有离开 Ledger

live_source.en: the live event stream, folded one record at a time. Nothing here is re-asked or polled - the same fold the server does, running in this page.
live_source.zh: 实时事件流，一条一条地折。这里不重问也不轮询——服务端做的那个折叠，在本页里跑一遍。

live_dropped.en: {dropped} earlier line(s) left this window; the ledger still has them
live_dropped.zh: {dropped} 条更早的行已滑出这个窗口；Ledger 里还留着

live_no_run_yet.en: no run has reported here yet
live_no_run_yet.zh: 还没有会话在这里报过

live_nothing_since.en: nothing has happened here since this page connected
live_nothing_since.zh: 本页连上之后这里什么都没发生

live_no_run_yet_what.en: this window holds what arrives from now on, so a run that finished before you opened this page is in the Ledger rather than here. Send work from the bar below and every turn it takes appears as it happens.
live_no_run_yet_what.zh: 这个窗口只装从现在起到达的东西，所以在你打开本页之前就结束的会话在 Ledger 里而不在这里。从下面那条栏派活，它的每一轮都会实时出现。

live_nothing_since_what.en: this window holds what arrived after the page connected. Earlier lines are in the Ledger, which the record page reads.
live_nothing_since_what.zh: 这个窗口装的是页面连上之后到达的行。更早的在 Ledger 里，记录页读的就是它。

live_pick_a_session.en: pick a session above to speak into it; what you send arrives at its next safe point
live_pick_a_session.zh: 先在上面点一个会话才能对它说话；你发的话会在它下一个安全点到达

live_steer_send.en: send at the next safe point

live_fork_from.en: branch a new run from step {seq}
live_fork_from.zh: 从第 {seq} 步分出一个新会话

live_intervention_note.en: A branch records where it came from and does not start working by itself. Taking over answers for this run from here; what it already did is not undone.
live_intervention_note.zh: 分叉只记录它从哪来，不会自己开始干活。接手是由你从这里替它作答；它已经做过的事不会被撤销。

city_scope.en: its buildings, how much work each has taken on, and which of them are busy right now
city_scope.zh: 它的楼、每栋接下了多少活、此刻哪几栋忙着

city_tower_note.en: a tower is as tall as the work its plan took on and lit as far up as that work is done; a lit window is a run in flight right now
city_tower_note.zh: 楼有多高取决于它的计划接下了多少活，亮到多高取决于做完了多少；一扇亮着的窗是此刻正在跑的一个会话

city_source.en: where the buildings stand comes from one query, asked when this page opened; which of them are lit is folded from the event stream, record by record, and is never polled
city_source.zh: 楼站在哪里来自打开本页时问的一次查询；哪几栋亮着是从事件流一条一条折出来的，从不轮询

city_no_buildings_what.en: a building is one line of business: its own rules, its own plan, its own archive, and the rooms work happens in. Raise one above and it appears here with the ground under it.
city_no_buildings_what.zh: 一栋楼是一条业务线：自己的规则、自己的计划、自己的归档，以及干活的那些房间。在上面盖一栋，它就会连同脚下的地一起出现在这里。

building_asking.en: asking {addr} what it has written down
building_asking.zh: 正在问 {addr} 写下了什么

building_asking_what.en: its plan, its decisions, its handoff and its archive are files on disk, read when this page asks
building_asking_what.zh: 它的计划、决定、交接与归档都是盘上的文件，本页问的时候才读

building_scope.en: the documents this building keeps, its archive, and what waits in each of its rooms. The figure counts rooms; this page reads and never writes.
building_scope.zh: 这栋楼留着的文档、它的归档，以及每个房间里等着的东西。数字数的是房间；本页只读不写。

building_source.en: the building's own directory on disk, read when this page asked. A room's queue is folded from the Ledger, so looking at it is not taking from it.
building_source.zh: 这栋楼在盘上的目录，本页问的时候读的。房间的队列是从 Ledger 折出来的，所以看一眼不等于取走。

building_no_rooms.en: no rooms yet - work here has not been given one
building_no_rooms.zh: 还没有房间——这里还没派过活

building_unreadable_row.en: this plan row could not be read - {problem}

building_asking_room.zh: 正在问 {room} 里等着什么

building_asking_room_what.en: until that answer arrives this page cannot say whether the room is empty, and will not guess
building_asking_room_what.zh: 答案到达之前本页说不出这个房间是不是空的，也不会猜

building_room_empty_what.en: another resident can leave a signal here, and a run in this room pulls it at its next safe point. Looking is not taking.
building_room_empty_what.zh: 别的居民可以在这里留一条信号，这个房间里的会话会在下一个安全点取走。看一眼不等于取走。

building_nothing_filed.en: nothing has been filed in this building
building_nothing_filed.zh: 这栋楼里还没有归档过任何东西

building_nothing_filed_what.en: a resident files what it settled and does not want to work out twice. What is here is what the next run in this building is told before it starts.
building_nothing_filed_what.zh: 居民把已经定下、不想再推一遍的东西归档。这里的东西就是下一个会话开工前会被告知的东西。

building_truncated.en: - shown up to the page's limit; the file on disk is longer
building_truncated.zh: — 只显示到本页的上限；盘上的文件更长

building_no_document.en: a building keeps five documents at most, and this one has not been written. The tabs above are the ones that exist.
building_no_document.zh: 一栋楼最多留五份文档，这一份还没写过。上面的页签是已经存在的那几份。

approval_title.en: what the city stopped to ask you

approval_scope.en: one row per action a gate escalated rather than decided; grouped where one answer can settle several
approval_scope.zh: 门没有自己决定而上交的动作各一行；一个回答能了结几件的就并成一组

approval_source.en: the approval queue as the city holds it, plus every approval_requested that has arrived since this page connected
approval_source.zh: 城里那份待批队列，加上本页连上之后到达的每一条 approval_requested

approval_none_escalated_what.en: a run reaches a person only when a door refuses to decide by itself - a write outside its domain, a discard with no way back, an action a policy has not yet settled. Until then work runs without asking.
approval_none_escalated_what.zh: 只有门自己不敢决定时才会找到人——写到域外、删了没有回头路、策略还没定过的动作。在那之前活自己往下跑，不问。

approval_tainted.en: this one began with someone else's text: answered alone, and no policy can waive it
approval_tainted.zh: 这一条起于别人的文本：只能单独回答，任何策略都免不了它

bin_restore_checkpoint.zh: 从 {at} 那个 checkpoint 恢复

bin_restore_stored.zh: 恢复 {at} 处存着的副本

bin_no_description.en: this build cannot describe how to restore it; the Ledger records the plan
bin_no_description.zh: 本构建说不出怎么恢复它；Ledger 里记着那个方案

bin_asking.en: asking the city what it discarded
bin_asking.zh: 正在问这座城丢弃过什么

bin_asking_what.en: the list appears when the answer arrives

bin_title.en: what was deleted, and the way back to each of it
bin_title.zh: 被删掉的东西，以及每一件的回头路

bin_scope.en: the newest first; the figure counts what has not been taken back yet, and rows that already came back stay listed as evidence that a return path works
bin_scope.zh: 最新的在前；数字数的是还没取回的，已经取回的行仍然列着，作为回头路管用的证据

bin_source.en: folded from the Ledger's file_discarded and discard_restored records; the way back is the Restoration the discard was constructed with
bin_source.zh: 折自 Ledger 的 file_discarded 与 discard_restored；回头路就是当初构造这次丢弃时带的那个 Restoration

bin_none_yet.zh: 还没有会话丢弃过东西

bin_none_yet_what.en: a deletion in this city cannot be constructed without a way back, so anything that disappears from a worktree lands here carrying the checkpoint or the content address it can be fetched from.
bin_none_yet_what.zh: 这座城里的删除没有回头路就构造不出来，所以从工作树里消失的东西都会落到这里，带着它的 checkpoint 或者内容地址。

bin_rollback.en: put the whole worktree back to that checkpoint
bin_rollback.zh: 把整个工作树拉回那个 checkpoint

bin_rollback_note.en: A checkpoint row can be rolled back, and that puts the whole worktree back to that point - not this one file. Rows whose way back is a content address or a rebuild have no button, because the wire has no command that restores one file, and a button that did nothing would be worse than the sentence beside it.
bin_rollback_note.zh: 带 checkpoint 的行可以回滚，那会把整个工作树拉回那一点——不是单独这一个文件。回头路是内容地址或重建说明的行不给按钮，因为线格式上没有恢复单个文件的命令，而一个按下去没反应的按钮比旁边这句话更糟。

ledger_nothing_said.en: the city has not said anything since this page connected
ledger_nothing_said.zh: 本页连上之后这座城什么都没说过

ledger_title.en: what this city has done, newest first
ledger_title.zh: 这座城做过的事，最新在前

ledger_scope.en: every kind of event, unless the two filters below narrow it; fifty rows to a page
ledger_scope.zh: 每一种事件，除非下面两个筛选把它收窄；一页五十行

ledger_source.en: the live event stream since this page connected. The Ledger on disk holds the rest, and `sprawling replay` verifies the chain over all of it - including the part this page never saw.
ledger_source.zh: 本页连上之后的实时事件流。其余的在盘上的 Ledger 里，`sprawling replay` 会对整条链验一遍——包括本页从未见过的那一段。

ledger_no_match.en: no record here matches that filter
ledger_no_match.zh: 这里没有记录匹配这个筛选

ledger_nothing_arrived.en: nothing has arrived since this page connected
ledger_nothing_arrived.zh: 本页连上之后什么都没到达

ledger_filter_note.en: the filter is a view over what this page holds, not over the Ledger. Widen it, or clear both fields to see everything that has arrived.
ledger_filter_note.zh: 筛选是对本页所持内容的一个视图，不是对 Ledger 的。放宽它，或者清空两个字段，就能看到已经到达的全部。

ledger_first_line_note.en: every effect in this city becomes an event before it happens, so the first line appears the moment work is sent from the bar below.
ledger_first_line_note.zh: 这座城里的每一个效果都先成为事件再发生，所以从下面那条栏派出活的一瞬间，第一行就会出现。

archive_title.en: what this city has written down

archive_hits.en: {total} hit(s) for “{needle}” in {shelves} building(s), read from the shelves just now
archive_hits.zh: “{needle}”在 {shelves} 栋楼里命中 {total} 条，刚从书架上读的

archive_scope.en: two sources, never merged: a search reads the shelves on disk at the moment you ask, and the list below it is folded from history. The same item can appear in both.
archive_scope.zh: 两个来源，恒不合并：搜索在你问的那一刻读盘上的书架，下面那份列表折自历史。同一件可以同时出现在两边。

ledger_skipped.zh: 略过了 {skipped} 条更新的记录

ledger_filtered_out.zh: 有 {count} 条记录被这个筛选挡住了

building_waiting_count.en: {count} waiting. Looking is not taking: a signal leaves this queue when a run pulls it.
building_waiting_count.zh: {count} 条在等。看一眼不等于取走：信号要等会话取走才离开这个队列。

settings_interface_title.en: the interface takes its type from your browser
settings_interface_title.zh: 界面的字体取自你的浏览器

settings_interface_scope.en: font family and base size only; everything else on this page is the city's
settings_interface_scope.zh: 只管字族与基准字号；本页其余都属于这座城

settings_interface_source.en: no font file ships with this binary and none is fetched from anywhere
settings_interface_source.zh: 本二进制不带任何字体文件，也不从任何地方取

settings_interface_faces.en: Text here is drawn with the two families your browser is set to use - the standard one for prose, the fixed-width one for numbers, addresses and hashes. To change either, open your browser's own font settings; in Chrome and Edge that is Appearance, then Customise fonts. Nothing needs to be set here, and nothing here overrides what you set there.
settings_interface_faces.zh: 这里的字用你浏览器设定的两个字族画：正文用标准那个，数字、地址与哈希用等宽那个。要改哪一个，就去开浏览器自己的字体设置；Chrome 与 Edge 在「外观」里的「自定义字体」。这里不需要设任何东西，也不会覆盖你在那边设的。

settings_interface_content.en: A city's own content - a building's name, a document, a ledger payload - can be in any language. Your system already holds a face for it, and this interface does not replace that choice with a guess of its own.
settings_interface_content.zh: 一座城自己的内容——楼名、文档、账本载荷——可以是任何语言。你的系统已经存着能画它的字，本界面不拿自己的猜测去替掉那个选择。

archive_source.en: the search reads each building's Archive directory; `filed lately` is folded from the Ledger's asset_archived records, which is why it can say when something was filed and by whom
archive_source.zh: 搜索读的是每栋楼的 Archive 目录；「最近归档」折自 Ledger 的 asset_archived，所以它说得出某件东西何时由谁归的档

archive_word_placeholder.en: a word the archives may hold
archive_word_placeholder.zh: 归档里可能有的一个词

archive_no_search_what.en: the shelves are read when you ask and not before, so an empty word searches nothing rather than everything. Type a word above.
archive_no_search_what.zh: 书架在你问的时候才读，所以空词搜的是「什么都不搜」而不是「全都搜」。在上面敲一个词。

archive_asking_filed.en: asking the record what was filed lately
archive_asking_filed.zh: 正在问记录最近归了什么档

archive_list_when_arrives.en: the list appears when the answer arrives

archive_nothing_filed_what.en: a run files an asset when it settles something worth not doing twice. The archive is what the next run is told before it starts, so it fills as work completes rather than as work begins.
archive_nothing_filed_what.zh: 会话在定下某件不值得再做一遍的事时归一份档。归档是下一个会话开工前会被告知的东西，所以它随着活干完而变多，而不是随着活开始。

cost_asking_spent.en: asking the city what it has spent
cost_asking_spent.zh: 正在问这座城花了多少

cost_asking_spent_what.en: the five cuts appear when the answer arrives; nothing is missing yet
cost_asking_spent_what.zh: 答案到了五个切面就出现；现在还不缺什么

cost_unpriced_title.en: work was done here, and no provider reported a price for it
cost_unpriced_title.zh: 这里干过活，但没有 provider 报过价

cost_unpriced_scope.en: every run in this city since it was raised, in five independent cuts. The rows are what was attributed; the amounts are missing because no call came back with one - a subscription or a local model reports what it used, not what it cost.
cost_unpriced_scope.zh: 这座城建成以来的每一个会话，五个互相独立的切面。行是归因出来的；金额缺失是因为没有一次调用带回价格——订阅制或本地模型报的是用量，不是花费。

cost_scope.en: every run in this city since it was raised, in five independent cuts of the same total
cost_scope.zh: 这座城建成以来的每一个会话，同一个总额的五个互相独立的切面

cost_source.en: folded from the Ledger's model_returned records; each cut sums to that same total, and an unattributed remainder stays visible rather than being divided away
cost_source.zh: 折自 Ledger 的 model_returned；每个切面加起来都是那同一个总额，归不出去的余额留在明面上而不是被摊掉

cost_none_billed.en: no model call has been billed in this city
cost_none_billed.zh: 这座城里没有一次模型调用被计过费

cost_none_billed_what.en: a run that reaches a provider is priced from that provider's own figure, and lands in all five cuts at once. Send work from the bar below and the money appears here.
cost_none_billed_what.zh: 够到 provider 的会话按那家自己给的数字计价，并一次落进五个切面。从下面那条栏派活，钱就会出现在这里。

cost_cut_empty.en: this cut has nothing in it: no call has been attributed to a {dimension} yet
cost_cut_empty.zh: 这个切面是空的：还没有调用被归到某个{dimension}上

cost_unpriced_calls.en: {count} call(s) came back with no price: a subscription or a local model reports what it used, not what it cost. Those calls are counted in tokens above and in no dollar figure anywhere.
cost_unpriced_calls.zh: 有 {count} 次调用回来时没带价钱：订阅或本地模型报的是用了多少，不是花了多少。这些调用计在上面的 token 里，不计在任何一个金额里。

cost_own_stream.en: {amount} of that arrived through this page's own stream
cost_own_stream.zh: 其中 {amount} 是从本页自己那条流里到的

turn_output_cut.en: {cut} more line(s), in the Ledger at {seq}
turn_output_cut.zh: 还有 {cut} 行，在账本第 {seq} 条

note_waiting.en: this turn stopped for a person to answer

note_discarded.en: {count} file(s) went away, each with its way back
note_discarded.zh: {count} 个文件没了，每个都带着回去的路

changed_nothing.en: nothing on disk has moved since this session opened
changed_nothing.zh: 这次会话开工以来，盘上没有东西动过

palette_placeholder.en: go to a page, a building or a session
palette_placeholder.zh: 去某一页、某栋楼或某个会话

palette_nothing_what.en: part of a page name, a building name or a session id is enough
palette_nothing_what.zh: 页名、楼名或会话 id 的一部分就够了

keys_scope.en: a letter on its own works outside a text box; the two with a modifier work everywhere
keys_scope.zh: 单个字母在输入框外才算；带修饰键的那两个到处都算

keys_palette.en: go to a page, a building or a session
keys_palette.zh: 去某一页、某栋楼或某个会话

keys_compose.en: start work here, or send what is already written
keys_compose.zh: 在这里开工，或送出已经写好的

keys_go.en: then o, c, s, a or l: overview, city, sessions, approvals, ledger
keys_go.zh: 再按 o、c、s、a 或 l：总览、城市、会话、审批、账本

alert_no_recovery.en: no way out was recorded with this refusal
alert_no_recovery.zh: 这条拒绝没有附带出路

alert_run_stopped.en: a run stopped and will not start itself again
alert_run_stopped.zh: 一个会话停了，它自己不会再启动

alert_provider_not_answering.en: the provider is not answering as it should

status_nothing_spent.en: nothing spent since this page connected
status_nothing_spent.zh: 本页连上之后没花过钱

status_awaiting_and_unreadable.en: {count} awaiting you - and {blind} this page cannot read
status_awaiting_and_unreadable.zh: {count} 件等你处理——另有 {blind} 件本页读不了

status_spent_some_unpriced.zh: 花了 {spent}——{used}——另有 {calls} 次调用没报价

route_no_such_page.en: this build has no page at {named}
route_no_such_page.zh: 本构建没有 {named} 这一页

route_no_such_page_recovery.en: the pages this build has are in the list on the left; the address bar shows the one you are on
route_no_such_page_recovery.zh: 本构建有的页面都在左栏那份列表里；地址栏显示的是你正在看的那一页

settings_needs_name.en: give this provider a name you will recognise later
settings_needs_name.zh: 给这个 provider 起个你以后认得出的名字

settings_needs_url.en: paste the base URL from the provider's documentation
settings_needs_url.zh: 把 provider 文档里的 base URL 贴进来

settings_url_not_safe.en: use https, or http only for a server on this machine
settings_url_not_safe.zh: 用 https；http 只允许指向本机的服务

settings_needs_dialect.en: say which wire this provider speaks
settings_needs_dialect.zh: 说明这个 provider 说哪种线格式

settings_main_consequence.en: without this, a dispatch is refused

settings_digest_consequence.en: without this, long documents are read whole by the main model
settings_digest_consequence.zh: 不选它，长文档会由主模型整篇读

settings_unknown_consequence.en: the effect of leaving this unset is not recorded
settings_unknown_consequence.zh: 不选它的后果没有记录在案

settings_stored_as.en: stored as {reference}; the key itself is now only in the vault
settings_stored_as.zh: 已存为 {reference}；密钥本身现在只在保险库里

settings_use_this_model.en: use this model for that job

settings_pick_provider.zh: 先选哪个 provider 提供它

settings_pick_job.en: say what this model is for
settings_pick_job.zh: 说明这个模型派什么用

settings_model_not_served.en: that endpoint does not list this model
settings_model_not_served.zh: 那个端点没有列出这个模型

settings_asking.en: asking the server what is attached
settings_asking.zh: 正在问服务端接着什么

settings_asking_what.en: providers, the model chosen for each job, and what is missing before this city can be dispatched to
settings_asking_what.zh: provider、每个活选定的模型，以及这座城能被派活之前还缺什么

settings_dispatchable.en: this city can be dispatched to

settings_not_dispatchable.en: no model answers for main, so a dispatch is refused
settings_not_dispatchable.zh: 没有模型答 main 这个活，所以派活会被拒

settings_scope.en: every provider attached to this city, and which of its models answers for each job
settings_scope.zh: 接到这座城上的每个 provider，以及各自哪个模型答哪个活

settings_source.en: the city's own endpoint book, re-read whenever a provider is attached or a model is chosen
settings_source.zh: 这座城自己那本端点账，每次接上 provider 或选定模型就重读一次

settings_no_provider_what.en: a run needs a model to answer for `main`. Attach one below with a base URL and a key, or sign in with a subscription. Nothing here is bundled and nothing is proxied - the endpoint is yours.
settings_no_provider_what.zh: 会话需要一个模型来答 `main`。在下面用 base URL 加密钥接一个，或者用订阅登录。这里不捆绑任何东西，也不代理任何东西——端点是你自己的。

settings_url_hint.en: https anywhere; http only to this machine
settings_url_hint.zh: https 任处；http 只到本机

settings_key_placeholder.en: the provider's key, or empty for a local server
settings_key_placeholder.zh: provider 的密钥；本机服务留空

settings_key_hint.en: it leaves this page for the machine's own credential vault and comes back as a reference; it is never put in a frame and never shown again
settings_key_hint.zh: 它离开本页直奔这台机器自己的凭证保险库，回来的是一条引用；它恒不进入任何帧，也不再显示

settings_put_key_in_vault.en: put the key in the vault

drop_recovery.en: drop it on a building or a room; work is aimed at a place, and the button below still starts it
drop_recovery.zh: 把它放到一栋楼或一个房间上；活是派往一个地方的，而下面那个按钮仍然是启动它的地方

drop_not_a_place.en: a run is something that happened at an address, not a place work can be put
drop_not_a_place.zh: 一个会话是在某个地址上发生过的事，不是一个可以放活进去的地方

drop_unreadable.en: this build could not read anything in what was dropped
drop_unreadable.zh: 这一版读不出被拖进来的东西里的任何内容

building_fuel.en: instruction budget for one sandboxed call
building_fuel.zh: 一次沙箱调用的指令预算

building_mounts.en: extra readable paths, one per line
building_mounts.zh: 额外可读路径，每行一条

building_servers.en: external servers, one per line as `label url` or `label ! command`
building_servers.zh: 外部服务器，每行一条，写成 `label url` 或 `label ! 命令`

building_servers_hint.en: an empty list is a building that reaches none, which is not the same as saying nothing
building_servers_hint.zh: 空表意味着这栋楼一个都不够到，与「什么都没说」不是一回事

building_save_reach.en: save what this building may reach
building_save_reach.zh: 保存这栋楼够得到的东西

settings_serves.en: what it serves; tick the ones this city may use
settings_serves.zh: 它供应的模型；勾选本城可以用的那些

settings_admit_all.en: nothing ticked admits everything it serves
settings_admit_all.zh: 一个都不勾即全部准入

settings_header_hint.en: empty lets the wire decide: an Anthropic key goes in x-api-key by itself, an OpenAI key in a bearer token; a name written here wins over both
settings_header_hint.zh: 留空由线格式决定：Anthropic 的密钥自动走 x-api-key，OpenAI 的走 bearer token；这里写了名字就以它为准

settings_declare_hint.en: one per line or comma separated; this is what registers when the endpoint cannot list its own models
settings_declare_hint.zh: 每行一个或用逗号分隔；端点列不出自己的模型时，注册的就是这份

settings_open_approvee_paste.en: open this, approve, and paste the code the provider shows you
settings_open_approvee_paste.zh: 打开它、批准，然后把 provider 显示的那串码贴回来

settings_code_label.en: the code the provider showed you
settings_code_label.zh: provider 显示给你的那串码

settings_choose_model_heading.en: choose a model for a job

settings_point_job_at_model.en: point this job at that model
settings_point_job_at_model.zh: 把这个活指向那个模型

board_scope.en: only leaves count: a branch's work is its children, and counting both would count the same effort twice
board_scope.zh: 只有叶子算数：一根枝的活就是它的子节点，两边都算等于把同一份力气数两遍

board_source.en: drawn from this building's Roadmap.md, which holds every state there is; this page keeps none of its own
board_source.zh: 画的是这栋楼的 Roadmap.md，状态全在那里，这一页自己不存

board_empty.en: this building has no plan yet

board_empty_what.en: send somebody to write one, and the tree grows as they split the work
board_empty_what.zh: 派个人去写一份，随后他们每拆一次活，这棵树就长一层

board_stuck_scope.en: one line per cause, never one per symptom
board_stuck_scope.zh: 一处原因一行，不是一个症状一行

board_stuck_source.en: from the plan, and from the record that says why it stopped
board_stuck_source.zh: 来自计划表，与说明它为什么停下的那条记录

settings_language.en: this interface reads in your language

settings_language_scope.en: what this client writes; never what the city wrote
settings_language_scope.zh: 只管这个客户端自己说的话，恒不改城写下的字

settings_language_source.en: your browser's own language, until you choose otherwise here
settings_language_source.zh: 默认取浏览器自己的语言设置，你在这里选了就以你选的为准
